idea-plugin.name: Oracle Plan Reader
idea-plugin.description:
Reads Oracle execution plans (the text output of DBMS_XPLAN) and points at what to fix. Paste a plan from SQL*Plus, SQLcl, SQL Developer, DataGrip or an application log, or select it in any editor or console, and get a report: the most expensive step, the problems found, and the plan as an indented tree with the cost share of every step. Works offline in every JetBrains IDE; no database connection needed.

Free checks

  • Most expensive step (self cost share of the total)
  • Full table scans of big row sources
  • Cartesian joins (usually a missing join condition)

Pro checks (licence or free trial)

  • Estimated vs actual rows off by 10x or more (ALLSTATS LAST plans)
  • Implicit data type conversion on a column (INTERNAL_FUNCTION, TO_NUMBER("COL"))
  • Functions on columns in filters (TRUNC, UPPER, NVL...) and LIKE '%...'
  • Nested loops driven by many rows, FILTER subqueries executed per row
  • No partition pruning (PARTITION RANGE ALL), index skip scans, big index full scans
  • Sorts and hash joins spilling to temp, remote access over database links, big sorts
  • Dynamic statistics and statistics feedback in the Note section

Use Tools | Analyze Oracle Execution Plan, the editor/console context menu, or the Plan Reader tool window.
